title: Portuguese Seitan Burger
description: A vegetarian take on the classic burger, using seitan and a hint of portuguese flavors.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cut the seitan into 4 equal pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the seitan for 4-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill.
Assemble the burgers with the seitan, lettuce, tomato, red bell pepper, and vegan cheese.
Drizzle with vegan mayo and top with portuguese bread crumbs.
Note: You can also bake the seitan in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
If using a grill pan, make sure to oil it before grilling the seitan to prevent sticking.
You can also add some sliced portuguese sausage to the burgers for extra flavor.
Don't forget to toast the buns on the grill for a crispy texture.
You can customize the burgers with your favorite toppings, such as sliced avocado or pickles.
